headline: Vendor blamejs v0.10.13 + drop locals now upstream

items.title: Vendored blamejs refreshed to v0.10.13
items.body: Re-clones `vendor/blamejs/` at v0.10.13 and updates `vendor/MANIFEST.json`. Local copies of helpers that have since landed upstream are dropped in favor of the framework versions, reducing the divergence surface.

items.title: README documents SPKI pinning + Prometheus sidecar + historical-stats framing
items.body: Adds operator-facing documentation for the v0.8.11 `pinnedServerSpki` config option, the v0.8.10 Prometheus sidecar exposition, and the framing of historical vs live stats reported by the `stats` CLI subcommand.
